brand.name: Janark
brand.tagline: India's first open source social platform
brand.support: Independent civic discussion, petitions, reports, and community voting — built in the open.

features.title: Discuss
features.body: Start open conversations on public issues with fellow citizens.

features.title: Raise issues
features.body: Document civic problems with context, location, and evidence.

features.title: Create petitions
features.body: Rally signatures for demands that serve the public interest.

features.title: Report problems
features.body: Flag hazards, gaps, and local concerns so they can be seen.

features.title: Vote & participate
features.body: Cast ballots on proposals and shape shared civic outcomes.

features.title: Discover
features.body: Explore trending topics, places, and conversations worth your time.

contribute.title: Help build {name}
contribute.body: JANARK is built in the open. Code, issues, and feedback all move the civic square forward.

feedbackModal.title: Send feedback
feedbackModal.intro: Tell us what works, what doesn’t, or what you’d like next. We read every note.
feedbackModal.emailPlaceholder: so we can follow up if needed
feedbackModal.successBody: Your feedback was received. We appreciate you helping build {name}.
feedbackModal.errorGeneric: Could not send feedback. Try again.

maintainers.title: Become a {name} Repository Maintainer
maintainers.body: Help maintain the {name} repository and build an open, independent civic platform. Apply with the essentials — tell us more only if you want to.

footer.support: A non-partisan civic square for citizens — browse free, act with phone OTP.
